purpose: Teach: 基幹/分譲/大差/特価/シチュエーション/通算/表題/ラインナップ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、基幹インフラの警備を強化しております
lines.en: We've been strengthening security measures at critical infrastructure.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Even pace. Slight formal distance. Delivers information as established fact, not seeking agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。分譲住宅地での防犯活動も進めておられますね
lines.en: I see. You're also advancing crime-prevention activities in residential subdivisions.
lines.style: Attentive, respectful listener. Nods through the words. Acknowledges what he's heard without interrupting the flow. Warm but formal.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、他犯と大差ないと判断した事件もあります
lines.en: There have been cases we assessed as not significantly different from other crimes.
lines.style: Neutral, matter-of-fact delivery. No inflection. The careful language of someone reading from experience. Brief pause before the acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。特価詐欺の被害を警察が摘発されたんですね
lines.en: I understand. So the police did crack down on those bargain-fraud cases.
lines.style: Following along with genuine interest. Small confirmation in the voice. Leans forward slightly with the realization. Not performative.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者のシチュエーションを丁寧に伺います
lines.en: We listen carefully to each victim's circumstances during investigation.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring tone. The words of someone trained in care. Slow enough that it sounds deliberate, not rushed. Suggests competence and attention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、通算検挙数を年次報告しております
lines.en: I see. You're reporting the total arrest numbers annually, then.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Takes in what's been said and reflects it back. No challenge. The ease of someone following a conversation he trusts.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査報告書の表題は明瞭にしております
lines.en: We keep the titles in our investigation reports clear and specific.
lines.style: Precise, controlled. Each word lands. No unnecessary softening. The voice of someone who has explained procedures many times and does it well.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察車両のラインナップを更新されたんですね
lines.en: I see. You've updated your police vehicle lineup then.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Slightly lighter than before. The small ease that comes at the end of a conversation. Acknowledges the detail without over-commenting.
